However, this 3-asset target package totals 254.0 C-AVI against JSN's 99.1 C-AVI, creating an insurmountable 154.9 C-AVI value deficit. To bridge this gap, All Hail King Jesus would be forced to include elite core starters such as Amon-Ra St. Brown and Tee Higgins, which severely net-downgrades All Hail King Jesus's starting lineup and defeats the primary goal. Simultaneously, trading Swift destroys Corgi Loaf Baking Co.'s starting RB2 slot without a viable internal replacement, eliminating their willingness to accept. Consequently, no realistic trade exists for this package under Market Reality standards.
